content.text: The text is a miscellany: excerpts on Mugsborough’s gas monopoly, Scott’s *The Lady of the Lake*, American stone, farming, lime kilns, apple jelly, grape cultivation, solar heat, surveying, birds, trees, and timber exhibitions. Its main narrative follows Cyril Crichton, who returns to his bedroom, travels to Geralton Castle after Lord Wilmersley’s murder, and investigates the disappearance of Lady Wilmersley. He meets detectives, servants, and Lady Upton, while hiding Anita, whom he met on a Newhaven train, in a nursing home and later at a London hotel. Cyril, Guy Campbell, and Judson debate the crime, jewels, French suspects, and Valdriguez’s secret marriage. Anita eventually visits Cyril’s lodgings, reveals recovered memories, and identifies him as her cousin.
